dropped_arms.parallel: Dirichlet-Neumann is sequential by construction: the Neumann piece needs the heat the Dirichlet piece sends

timing_note: mean of the per-macro-step wall time of the adapter's step alone, arms taking turns in a rotating order, inside the workbench server process

checks.title: Energy: heat in = heat stored
checks.registered: 2026-09-28, before the conduction family's first run
checks.measure: |heat into the domain through its edges - heat stored| over the heat through the plate, every step, worst arm (steady: stored = 0)
checks.why: the full domain closes to the direct solver's round-off. A decomposed arm closes to its iteration's floor: the solve stops when the update is below 1e-10 of the temperature scale, and a heat flow is a temperature difference over a half-cell, so its relative error is that times T/dT, with the material contrast, well under 1e-6

checks.title: Temperatures agree with the full domain
checks.registered: 2026-09-28, before the conduction family's first run
checks.measure: max |T_decomposed - T_full| over the temperature span of the fixed boundaries, at the last step
checks.why: both solve the same finite volumes; the converged decomposition IS the full-domain solution up to the iteration's tolerance (Dirichlet-Neumann's converged face flow is the harmonic-mean face exactly)
checks.detail: max |dT| = 2.69e-11 K over a span of 100 K

checks.title: Heat flow = dT / sum(L/k) (a layered wall)
checks.registered: 2026-09-28, before the conduction family's first run
checks.measure: |Q - Q_closed| / Q_closed for every arm, where Q_closed = dT H / sum_i L_i / k_i; only for a steady wall of layers across x with fixed temperatures left and right and insulated top and bottom
checks.why: harmonic-mean faces add the half-cells' resistances in series, so the discrete heat flow through layers on cell faces is the closed form to round-off; a decomposed arm adds its iteration floor

checks.title: Threaded equals serial, bit for bit (style B)
checks.registered: 2026-09-28, before the conduction family's first run
checks.measure: np.array_equal on the temperature after every step
checks.why: additive Schwarz solves every window from the same iterate and blends in window order, so the order the threads finish in cannot change a bit
checks.detail: style C has no threaded arm

notes: Dirichlet side: steel; Neumann side: copper. The 1-D contraction factor rho = k_D L_N / (k_N L_D) = 0.075 (under 1: the unrelaxed iteration would contract). First relaxation factor 0.5, then Aitken's rule.
Steady: every 'step' is the whole solve again from the initial temperature, repeated to time it; the answer is the same each time.
